newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest direct hogs $0.50-$1.00 lower-dealers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest direct hogs $0.50-$1.00 lower-dealers.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hogs Friday sold $0.50 to $1.00 per cwt lower amid light demand from packers still fighting unprofitable operating margins, livestock dealers said.
Packer demand also was thin following hefty hog movement during the holiday-shortened week, they said.
Outlooks for a light Saturday slaughter also kept sales light, sources said.
Interior Iowa/southern Minnesota hogs sold $1.00 lower in light activity at $53.00 to $54.50 in the country and $55.00 to $56.00 at plants, dealers and packer buyers there said.
